Design Thinking-A Primer || NPTEL 2026
Developed an AI-powered smart city web application that enables citizens to report civic issues and natural disasters with images and
location details. Leveraged AI to automatically classify reported issues and enabled real-time complaint tracking, helping authorities

Autonomous Student Academic Advisor – Agentic AI GitHub
Tech Stack: Python (Flask/FastAPI), React, LucideIcons
Built a personalized internship recommendation system with a Python (Flask/FastAPI) backend and a React frontend, matching user
skills and interests to relevant internship opportunities through an interactive interface. Implemented a structured data pipeline to
organize internship listings, enabling the system to filter and rank opportunities based on user profiles. Used Lucide icons to build a
clean, intuitive UI, and structured the backend as RESTAPIs to keep the frontend and recommendation logic decoupled for easier
maintenance and future scalability. 
ChronoExchange – A Digital Time Banking System GitHub 
Tech Stack: MERN Stack (React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB), Socket.io, JWT, Tailwind CSS
Developed a full-stack digital time banking platform that enables users to exchange services using time credits instead of money,
allowing community members to offer skills, request services, and earn or spend credits through a secure and transparent exchange
process.Implemented a complete service exchange workflow including service posting, request management, provider approval, real-
time chat after request acceptance, automatic credit transfer upon successful service completion, and a rating and review system.
Built a role-based admin dashboard to manage users, services, requests, transactions, and platform analytics using real-time data
from MongoDB, while ensuring secure authentication with JWT and encrypted passwords using bcrypt.
